== Description ==
'''DCAT-55''' is the final '''CAT''' entity in The [[Super Epic Mode]], His appearance is an old "This is Cat D" meme but with green effect.

== Behavior ==
When '''DCAT-55''' spawns, it will make distorted cat sounds then it will rush to current room and check the heavy lockers/supply cabinets then retreat, then it will come back again and check lockers again, after that it will retreat again and despawn.

==Strategy & Tips==
When you hear Distorted Meowing Sounds, hide in a blue locker or in a previous room, as he will check the heavy lockers/supply cabinets in current room, he disables [[Claustrophobia]] so use for your advantage
